column3:
Does the governance framework
recognize the need to equitably
treat all shareholders, including
the minority and foreign
shareholders?
column6:
Yes. Contained in the Articles of
Association.

column3:
Other than at the AGM, how does
the Board facilitate the effective
exercise of shareholders' rights?
column6:
Public notice to all shareholders
in the instance there are changes
that are material.

column3:
How does the Board facilitate
shareholders participation at the
AGM?
column6:
Public notices within the
stipulated time, including the
agenda, venue and
documentation for discussion at
the meeting.

column3:
Are minority and foreign
shareholders holding the same
class of shares treated equitably?
